brief:
Security forces apprehended a vehicle carrying armed men after they opened fire near the Ghazali intersection in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting wounded three civilians in the area.

The incident prompted an immediate response from the security apparatus, which moved to intercept the suspects' vehicle. Authorities said they took the gunmen into custody following the incident. The circumstances that led to the shooting and the identities of those detained were not immediately disclosed.
